indicator.name: Statistics of Zakat Payments and Major Benefactors by Zakat Collection Channels for the Period (2025) (No Poverty _ Decent Work and Economic Growth)
indicator.definition: A report reviewing Zakat collection channels and the total number of payers and Zakat funds collected by year, highlighting the contribution to Sustainable Development Goals, specifically Goals 1 and 8: No Poverty and Decent Work and Economic Growth.
indicator.sdg_alignment: SDG 1 (No Poverty), SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth)
